name: ticket-summarizer
description: Fetches Azure DevOps or Jira work items, either an explicit list of tickets or everything matching a date range and status (active, or delivered/closed between two dates), and summarizes each into a plain-language, client-facing blurb suited for a status update deck: concise, targeting one to two sentences and extending to three or four only as a last resort. States what was delivered and, only when the ticket itself supports it, why it matters; never invents a business-value claim. Read-only: no tracker writes, no confirmation gate. Auto-installs issuekit; bring your own MCPs.
